sites.intro: Pages of programs and selection processes that joBot checks from time to time. When a page's text changes, the change shows up here and in the Programs tab of the jobs.
sites.vazio: You are not following any page yet. Add the first one below.
sites.dica.url: Paste the full address, starting with http:// or https://. Public pages on the internet only.
sites.remover_aviso: Remove the page "{nome}"? The saved text and its changes will be deleted.
sites.estado.falhou: The page could not be read on the last try. {motivo} The last text read was kept.
sites.erro.nome: Give the page a name of up to 100 characters.
sites.erro.endereco: This address cannot be followed. Use the full address of a public page (http:// or https://) that is not on your local network.
sites.motivo.fora_do_ar: The page seems to be down or did not answer.
sites.motivo.bloqueada: The site blocked the request or asked us to wait, and joBot does not try to get around that.
sites.motivo.nao_e_texto: The page is a file that is not text (PDF, image), which joBot cannot compare.
sites.motivo.endereco_recusado: The address is not allowed (local network or invalid address).
sites.motivo.grande_demais: The page is too large to be read.
sites.motivo.erro: An unexpected error happened while reading the page.
sites.motivo.desconhecido: It may be down, blocked, or a file that is not text (PDF, image).
